summary: Tool collection web app with categories, user authentication, admin panel, and dashboard. Currently implementing usage tracking foundation with placeholder values and admin reset capabilities.
architectural_notes: Usage tracking system designed with backend data structures to support future quota enforcement without restructuring
Weekly periods reset every Monday at UTC midnight for quota calculations
Tool usage counted per submission when result is successfully generated
Admin panel includes manual user statistics reset capability
known_issues: Category links in header menu use incorrect /categories/{slug} pattern instead of working /category/{slug} pattern
Dashboard displays incorrect usage data (shows 9114 for most metrics)
Intermittent performance issues with 10-15 second load times occurring randomly across pages including dashboard

existing_features.title: Update the Dashboard page to display placeholder values (0 or sensible fixed numbers) for all usage statistics instead of the current incorrect values (9114). This includes: Usage This Week, Tools Used This Week, Total Usage, Saved Tools, Daily Quota remaining, daily uses, Weekly Quota remaining, weekly uses, Today's Usage, and Average Daily.

Create an admin panel page for resetting user usage statistics. The admin should be able to select a user and reset all their usage counts (daily usage, weekly usage, total usage, saved tools count) back to zero.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix dashboard to show placeholder values instead of incorrect 9114 counts
Add admin feature to manually reset user usage statistics/quotas
Standardize category URLs in header menu from /categories/{slug} to /category/{slug}

Add backend data structures to support future usage tracking implementation. Create stable types and storage for user usage records (timestamp, tool ID, user ID) without implementing automatic tracking logic yet.
